sourceNotes: This brand has no discovered color-code document (unlike kaduse-medikal, iyilesme-kanali, or turkiye-scholarships). Fetched directly from the logo pack's own pixel data via dominant-color clustering on the avatar and tea-glass marks, per explicit instruction to fetch from the visuals when no color page exists. Burgundy #501818 (tea-glass fill) and Navy #0A0F1A (circular badge background) are the two clearly dominant hues; Ivory #F0EFE4 is the glass's light band / icon-only white base. A red/gold nazar (evil-eye) ring is visible in the artwork but too small at this source resolution (72-318px canvases) to sample a reliable hex value -- not included as a named role to avoid guessing. accent duplicates primary since no second brand hue was measurable. Two logo-pack folders existed for this channel with overlapping/colliding file numbering; the cleaner, complete three-treatment sets (avatar, tea-glass, primary) were used and the redundant/incomplete sets (a separate 'circular' pair with no original, and a 'monogram' lettermark) were left unused.
